title: RustLlvmCoverageRunnerContract
description: Local/static contract for future Buck2-native LLVM source-based Rust coverage runner targets. This contract records the target shape; it does not generate coverage reports or prove live cloud-ci authority by itself.

_meta.source_request: Founder directive 2026-06-03: use Buck2-native LLVM source-based coverage instead of Tarpaulin, keep modern Rust standards, and preserve dual Cargo+Buck2 local mutation ergonomics.

official_references.name: rustc Book — Instrumentation-based Code Coverage
official_references.used_for: rustc -C instrument-coverage and LLVM_PROFILE_FILE profile emission.

official_references.name: LLVM — Source-based Code Coverage
official_references.used_for: llvm-profdata merge and llvm-cov report/export pipeline.

official_references.name: Buck2 — Commands
official_references.used_for: Buck2 target-based build/test/run evidence and Build ID capture.

claim_boundary.note: Contract/target-shape evidence only. This does not generate a coverage report, run a live candidate coverage lane, post statuses, mutate branch protection, prove P0.0 green, prove Phase-0 completion, prove production readiness, or prove hyperscaler-grade readiness.

coverage_pipeline.noncanonical_surface: Tarpaulin is not required CI/PR coverage evidence for this monorepo
forbidden_authority: Tarpaulin as canonical monorepo coverage evidence
ad-hoc local coverage output as merge authority
candidate-authored target inventory as coverage authority

toolchain_requirements.local_smoke_llvm_tools_source: active rustc sysroot rustlib host bin (rustup llvm-tools component)
toolchain_requirements.live_runner_llvm_tools_source: trusted cloud-ci/oya-ci Buck2 toolchain inventory before production coverage budgets or merge authority
toolchain_requirements.pinning_requirement: Coverage authority must pin the Rust/LLVM toolchain through the trusted Buck2/cloud-ci inventory; ambient host PATH tools are local smoke convenience only.

smoke_coverage.budget_authority: none; fixture smoke verifies toolchain/report mechanics only
smoke_coverage.claim_boundary: No P0.0 green, Phase-0 completion, production readiness, hyperscaler-grade readiness, or live required-context authority.
